summary: Regentis Biomaterials Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the withdrawal of its Registration Statement on Form F-1 (File No. 333-295510) effective June 15, 2026, abandoning its planned public offering. No financial terms, stake, or premium apply as no transaction was consummated. The board decided not to pursue the offering; no advisors named. This is a withdrawal of a securities registration, not a special situation. Watch for alternative financing or strategic alternatives.
